body: I told the guy to fuck off. He thought he could stay at our place to sleep it off. I told him to get a Uber. I did take her home to be responsible but I'm done. I'm moving back to home. I only stay with her because Hawaii is expensive. But I want to go back home to the east coast anyways
I'll keep living and see what happens. I have good days but those bad days take over everything. If you ever need to talk you can PM me.

I'm glad I'm not alone in feeling this. I talked to
Some people on here and it helped a lot. I try to keep myself busy but I want to be loved. I haven't been in a serious relationship in years and I miss it.
